### **Libraries used in this file**

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(pROC)
```

### **Reading in the raw data**

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
raw_data <- read_csv("../data/bbl_all.csv")
raw_data_1 <- read_csv("../data/bbl_match_info.csv")
```

### **Feature Engineering**

The code chunk below contains the required data manipulation and variable engineering required to answer and understand the dashboard.

```{r}
db_data <- raw_data |>
  
  # date
  mutate(
    match_date = format(start_date, "%d/%m/%y")
  ) |>
  relocate(match_date, .after = season) |>
  
  
  # remove / relocate unnecessary variables
  relocate(start_date, .after = fielder_3) |>
  select(
    -penalty,
    -other_wicket_type
  ) |>
  
  
  # over
  mutate(
    over = floor(actual_delivery) + 1
  ) |>
  relocate(over, .after = actual_delivery) |>
  
  
  # rearrange important delivery variables
  relocate(
    runs_off_bat,
    extras,
    wides,
    noballs,
    byes,
    legbyes,
    wicket_type,
    .after = over
  ) |>
  
  # phase of the game
  mutate(
    Phase_over = case_when(
      over <= 6 ~ "Powerplay",
      over <= 16 ~ "Mid-Game",
      over <= 20 ~ "Death"
    )
  ) |>
  relocate(Phase_over, .after = over) |>
  
  #delivery order
  arrange(start_date, match_id, innings) |> 
   group_by(match_id,
            innings) |>
  mutate(  delivery_order = row_number() ) |>
  
  ungroup() |>
  
   # target runs
  left_join(
    raw_data_1 |>
      select(match_id, target_runs),
    by = "match_id") |>
  relocate(target_runs, .after = innings) |>
  
  # wicket on current delivery
  mutate(
    wicket_this_ball = case_when(
      is.na(wicket_type) ~ 0,
      wicket_type == "retired hurt" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ 1) ) |>
  relocate(
    wicket_this_ball, .after = wicket_type) |>
  
  #replace NA with 0
  mutate(
    extras = ifelse(is.na(extras), 0, extras),
    wides = ifelse(is.na(wides), 0, wides),
    noballs = ifelse(is.na(noballs), 0, noballs),
    byes = ifelse(is.na(byes), 0, byes),
    legbyes = ifelse(is.na(legbyes), 0, legbyes) 
    ) |>
  
  # runs on current delivery
  mutate(runs_this_ball = runs_off_bat + extras) |>
  relocate(
    runs_this_ball, .after = wicket_this_ball) |>
  
  
  #rearrange main match variables
  relocate(
    innings,
    target_runs,
    ball,
    actual_delivery,
    over,
    Phase_over,
    wides,
    noballs,
    byes,
    legbyes,
    extras,
    wicket_this_ball,
    wicket_type,
    runs_off_bat,
    runs_this_ball,
    .after = match_date
  ) |>
  
  #cumulative match score
  group_by(match_id, innings) |>
  mutate(
    cumulative_runs = cumsum(runs_this_ball),
    cumulative_wickets = cumsum(wicket_this_ball),
    score = paste0(
      cumulative_runs,
      "/",
      cumulative_wickets
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  
  # cumulative extras
  group_by(
    match_id,
    innings
  ) |>
  mutate(
    cumulative_extras = cumsum(extras),
    cumulative_wides = cumsum(wides),
    cumulative_noballs = cumsum(noballs),
    cumulative_byes = cumsum(byes),
    cumulative_legbyes = cumsum(legbyes) ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  
  
   # phase cumulative score
  group_by(
    match_id,
    innings,
    Phase_over
  ) |>
  mutate(
    phase_runs = cumsum(runs_this_ball),
    phase_wickets = cumsum(wicket_this_ball),
    phase_extras = cumsum(extras),
    phase_wides = cumsum(wides),
    phase_noballs = cumsum(noballs),
    phase_byes = cumsum(byes),
    phase_legbyes = cumsum(legbyes) ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  
  
  #legal delivery
  mutate(
    legal_ball = case_when(
      !is.na(wides) & wides > 0 ~ 0,
      !is.na(noballs) & noballs > 0 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ 1
    )
  ) |>
  
  #cumulative legal deliveries
  group_by(
    match_id,
    innings
  ) |>
  mutate(
    cumulative_legal_balls = cumsum(legal_ball)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  
  # runs, wickets before current ball
  mutate(
    runs_before_ball = cumulative_runs - runs_this_ball,
    wickets_before_ball = cumulative_wickets - wicket_this_ball
  ) |>
  relocate(
    runs_before_ball,
    .after = runs_this_ball
  ) |>
  relocate(
    wickets_before_ball,
    .after = wicket_this_ball
  ) |>

  
  #current team run rate
  mutate(
    team_run_rate = case_when(
      cumulative_legal_balls > 0 ~
        (cumulative_runs / cumulative_legal_balls) * 6,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

#scoring rate engineering
#by season, team, oppn, over
scoring_rate_season_over <- db_data |>
  group_by(
    season,
    batting_team,
    bowling_team,
    over,
    Phase_over
  ) |>
  summarise(
    
    total_runs =
      sum(
        runs_this_ball,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    total_legal_balls =
      sum(
        legal_ball,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    total_extras =
      sum(
        extras,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    total_wickets =
      sum(
        wicket_this_ball,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    matches_played =
      n_distinct(
        match_id
      ),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  
  mutate(
  
  over_run_rate =
    case_when(
      total_legal_balls > 0 ~
        (total_runs / total_legal_balls) * 6,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
  
  wickets_per_match =
    case_when(
      matches_played > 0 ~
        total_wickets / matches_played,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(
    season,
    batting_team,
    bowling_team,
    over
  )
```

### **Batsmen feature engineering**

```{r}
#batsman runs within the innings
db_data <- db_data |>
  group_by(
    match_id,
    innings,
    striker
  ) |>
  mutate(
    batsmen_cumulative_runs =
      cumsum(runs_off_bat),

    batsmen_runs_before_ball =
      batsmen_cumulative_runs - runs_off_bat
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  relocate(
    batsmen_runs_before_ball,
    batsmen_cumulative_runs,
    .after = score
  )

#batsmen data
batsman_data <- db_data |>
  select(
    match_id,
    season,
    match_date,
    innings,
    target_runs,
    
    #delivery information
    over,
    ball,
    actual_delivery,
    legal_ball,
    cumulative_legal_balls,
    Phase_over,
    
    #extras
    extras,
    wides,
    noballs,
    byes,
    legbyes,
    
    #wicket information
    wicket_this_ball,
    wickets_before_ball,
    wicket_type,
    player_dismissed,
    
    #batting / scoring information
    runs_off_bat,
    runs_this_ball,
    runs_before_ball,
    cumulative_runs,
    cumulative_wickets,
    score,
    team_run_rate,
    phase_runs,
    phase_wickets,
    
    #player / team information
    batting_team,
    striker,
    non_striker,
    batsmen_cumulative_runs,
    batsmen_runs_before_ball,
    bowling_team,
    bowler,
    
    #match context
    venue,
    delivery_order
  )

#batsmen against each team
batsman_opposition_stats <- batsman_data |>
  group_by(
    season,
    striker,
    bowling_team
  ) |>
  summarise(
    total_runs_opposition = sum(runs_off_bat, na.rm = TRUE),
    innings_vs_opposition = n_distinct(match_id, innings),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    runs_per_innings_opposition =
      total_runs_opposition / innings_vs_opposition
  ) |>
  arrange(
    season,
    striker,
    desc(runs_per_innings_opposition)
  )

#batsmen contribution against win-lose
batsman_won_lost_match <- batsman_data |>
  
  # Add winning team
  left_join(
    raw_data_1 |>
      select(match_id, winner) |>
      distinct(),
    by = "match_id"
  ) |>
  
  # Identify result
  mutate(
    match_result = case_when(
      is.na(winner) ~ NA_character_,
      batting_team == winner ~ "Won",
      batting_team != winner ~ "Lost"
    )
  ) |>
  
  # One row = one batter in one innings
  group_by(
    season,
    match_id,
    innings,
    striker,
    batting_team,
    bowling_team,
    match_result
  ) |>
  summarise(
    innings_runs = sum(runs_off_bat, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  
  arrange(
    season,
    striker,
    match_id
  )


#batsmen type of dimissals
batsman_dismissal_stats <- db_data |>
  filter(
    !is.na(player_dismissed),
    wicket_this_ball == 1
  ) |>
  group_by(
    season,
    player_dismissed,
    wicket_type
  ) |>
  summarise(
    dismissals = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(
    season,
    player_dismissed,
    desc(dismissals)
  )

#batsmen innings
batsman_innings_data <- batsman_data |>
  mutate(
    batter_ball = case_when(
      wides > 0 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ 1
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(
    season,
    match_id,
    innings,
    striker
  ) |>
  summarise(
    match_date = first(match_date),
    batting_team = first(batting_team),
    bowling_team = first(bowling_team),
    venue = first(venue),

    innings_runs = sum(runs_off_bat, na.rm = TRUE),
    balls_faced = sum(batter_ball, na.rm = TRUE),

    strike_rate = case_when(
      balls_faced > 0 ~
        (innings_runs / balls_faced) * 100,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(
    striker,
    match_date,
    match_id
  )

```

### **Pressure code chunk**

```{r}
#Removing shortened matches and do a sanity check of how many of them are there in the data-set
second_innings_check <- db_data |>
  filter(innings == 2) |>
  group_by(
    match_id,
    season,
    batting_team,
    bowling_team,
    target_runs
  ) |>
  summarise(
    legal_balls_bowled =
      sum(legal_ball, na.rm = TRUE),

    final_runs =
      max(cumulative_runs, na.rm = TRUE),

    final_wickets =
      max(cumulative_wickets, na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    target_reached =
      final_runs >= target_runs,

    all_out =
      final_wickets >= 10
  )


shortened_matches <- second_innings_check |>
  filter(
    legal_balls_bowled < 120,
    target_reached == FALSE,
    all_out == FALSE
  ) |>
  arrange(
    legal_balls_bowled
  )
shortened_matches

pressure_data <- db_data |>
  
  # only second innings = chasing team and removing interrupted matches - rain/retired hurt batsmen
  filter(
    innings == 2,
    !is.na(target_runs),
    !match_id %in% shortened_matches$match_id
  ) |>
  
  # add match winner
  left_join(
    raw_data_1 |>
      select(
        match_id,
        winner
      ),
    by = "match_id"
  ) |>
  
  # create match state BEFORE the current delivery
  mutate(
    
    legal_balls_before_ball =
      cumulative_legal_balls - legal_ball,
    
    balls_remaining =
      120 - legal_balls_before_ball,
    
    runs_required =
      pmax(
        target_runs - runs_before_ball,
        0
      ),
    
    wickets_in_hand =
      10 - wickets_before_ball,
    
    required_run_rate =
      case_when(
        balls_remaining > 0 ~
          (runs_required / balls_remaining) * 6,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
    
    # final outcome of the chase
    chase_win =
      case_when(
        is.na(winner) ~ NA_integer_,
        batting_team == winner ~ 1L,
        TRUE ~ 0L
      )
  ) |>
  
  # keep only variables required for the model
  select(
    match_id,
    season,
    required_run_rate,
    wickets_in_hand,
    balls_remaining,
    chase_win
  ) |>
  
  # remove unusable observations
  filter(
    !is.na(required_run_rate),
    !is.na(wickets_in_hand),
    !is.na(balls_remaining),
    !is.na(chase_win),
    balls_remaining > 0
  )
```

### **Logistic Model**

```{r}
match_ids <- unique(pressure_data$match_id)

train_ids <- sample(
  match_ids,
  size = 0.8 * length(match_ids)
)

pressure_train <- pressure_data |>
  filter(match_id %in% train_ids)

pressure_test <- pressure_data |>
  filter(!match_id %in% train_ids)
```

```{r}
pressure_model <- glm(
  chase_win ~
    required_run_rate +
    wickets_in_hand +
    balls_remaining,
  
  data = pressure_train,
  family = binomial
)

summary(pressure_model)
```

```{r}
pressure_test <- pressure_test |>
  mutate(
    predicted_probability = predict(
      pressure_model,
      newdata = pressure_test,
      type = "response"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
summary(pressure_test$predicted_probability)
```

```{r}
pressure_test |>
  select(
    match_id,
    required_run_rate,
    wickets_in_hand,
    balls_remaining,
    chase_win,
    predicted_probability
  ) |>
  head(20)
```

```{r}
pressure_test <- pressure_test |>
  mutate(
    predicted_class = ifelse(
      predicted_probability >= 0.5,
      1,
      0
    )
  )

mean(
  pressure_test$predicted_class ==
    pressure_test$chase_win
)
```

```{r}
table(
  Actual = pressure_test$chase_win,
  Predicted = pressure_test$predicted_class
)
```

```{r}
accuracy <- mean(
  pressure_test$predicted_class ==
    pressure_test$chase_win
)

accuracy
```

```{r}
roc_pressure <- roc(
  pressure_test$chase_win,
  pressure_test$predicted_probability
)

auc(roc_pressure)
```

### **Actual Model**

```{r}
pressure_model <- glm(
  chase_win ~
    required_run_rate +
    wickets_in_hand +
    balls_remaining,
  
  data = pressure_data,
  family = binomial
)
```

```{r}
pressure_data <- pressure_data |>
  mutate(
    predicted_probability = predict(
      pressure_model,
      newdata = pressure_data,
      type = "response"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
pressure_data <- pressure_data |>
  mutate(
    pressure_score =
      1 - predicted_probability
  )
```

```{r}
pressure_cutoffs <- quantile(
  pressure_data$pressure_score,
  probs = c(0.25, 0.75),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

pressure_cutoffs
```

```{r}
pressure_data <- pressure_data |>
  mutate(
    pressure_level = case_when(
      
      pressure_score <= pressure_cutoffs[1] ~
        "Low Pressure",
      
      pressure_score >= pressure_cutoffs[2] ~
        "High Pressure",
      
      TRUE ~
        "Medium Pressure"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
pressure_data <- pressure_data |>
  mutate(
    predicted_class = ifelse(
      predicted_probability >= 0.5,
      1,
      0 ))
```

```{r}
training_accuracy <- mean(
  pressure_data$predicted_class ==
    pressure_data$chase_win
)

training_accuracy
```

```{r}
table(
  Actual = pressure_data$chase_win,
  Predicted = pressure_data$predicted_class
)
```

```{r}
roc_pressure_all <- roc(
  pressure_data$chase_win,
  pressure_data$predicted_probability
)

auc(roc_pressure_all)
```

### **Batsmen Pressure**

```{r}
batter_pressure_data <- db_data |>
  
  # only valid chasing innings
  filter(
    innings == 2,
    !is.na(target_runs),
    !match_id %in% shortened_matches$match_id,
    !is.na(striker)
  ) |>
  
  # recreate match state before each delivery
  mutate(
    
    legal_balls_before_ball =
      cumulative_legal_balls - legal_ball,
    
    balls_remaining =
      120 - legal_balls_before_ball,
    
    runs_required =
      pmax(
        target_runs - runs_before_ball,
        0
      ),
    
    wickets_in_hand =
      10 - wickets_before_ball,
    
    required_run_rate =
      case_when(
        balls_remaining > 0 ~
          (runs_required / balls_remaining) * 6,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
    
    # wides do not count as balls faced
    batter_ball =
      case_when(
        wides > 0 ~ 0,
        TRUE ~ 1
      )
  ) |>
  
  # remove unusable match states
  filter(
    !is.na(required_run_rate),
    !is.na(wickets_in_hand),
    !is.na(balls_remaining),
    balls_remaining > 0
  )
```

```{r}
# using final pressure model
  batter_pressure_data$predicted_probability <- predict(
  pressure_model,
  newdata = batter_pressure_data,
  type = "response"
)
```

```{r}
batter_pressure_data <- batter_pressure_data |>
  mutate(
    pressure_score =
      1 - predicted_probability,
    
    pressure_level =
      case_when(
        pressure_score <= pressure_cutoffs[1] ~
          "Low Pressure",
        
        pressure_score >= pressure_cutoffs[2] ~
          "High Pressure",
        
        TRUE ~
          "Medium Pressure"
      )
  )
```

```{r}
batter_pressure_performance <- batter_pressure_data |>
  group_by(
    season,
    batting_team,
    bowling_team,
    striker,
    pressure_level
  ) |>
  summarise(
    
    runs =
      sum(
        runs_off_bat,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    balls_faced =
      sum(
        batter_ball,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    matches =
      n_distinct(
        match_id
      ),
    
    strike_rate =
      case_when(
        balls_faced > 0 ~
          (runs / balls_faced) * 100,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
    
    average_pressure_score =
      mean(
        pressure_score,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(
    season,
    batting_team,
    striker,
    pressure_level
  )
```

```{r}
batter_pressure_summary <- batter_pressure_data |>
  group_by(
    batting_team,
    striker
  ) |>
  summarise(
    
    matches =
      n_distinct(
        match_id
      ),
    
    total_runs =
      sum(
        runs_off_bat,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    total_balls_faced =
      sum(
        batter_ball,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    overall_strike_rate =
      case_when(
        total_balls_faced > 0 ~
          (total_runs / total_balls_faced) * 100,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
    
    average_pressure_score =
      mean(
        pressure_score,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    high_pressure_balls =
      sum(
        pressure_level == "High Pressure" &
          batter_ball == 1,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    medium_pressure_balls =
      sum(
        pressure_level == "Medium Pressure" &
          batter_ball == 1,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    low_pressure_balls =
      sum(
        pressure_level == "Low Pressure" &
          batter_ball == 1,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
batter_high_low <- batter_pressure_data |>
  filter(
    pressure_level %in%
      c(
        "High Pressure",
        "Low Pressure"
      )
  ) |>
  group_by(
    batting_team,
    striker,
    pressure_level
  ) |>
  summarise(
    
    runs =
      sum(
        runs_off_bat,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    balls_faced =
      sum(
        batter_ball,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    matches =
      n_distinct(
        match_id
      ),
    
    strike_rate =
      case_when(
        balls_faced > 0 ~
          (runs / balls_faced) * 100,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
batter_pressure_comparison <- batter_high_low |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from =
      pressure_level,
    
    values_from =
      c(
        runs,
        balls_faced,
        matches,
        strike_rate
      ),
    
    names_sep = "_"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    
    strike_rate_difference =
      `strike_rate_High Pressure` -
      `strike_rate_Low Pressure`,
    
    runs_difference =
      `runs_High Pressure` -
      `runs_Low Pressure`
  ) |>
  arrange(
    desc(strike_rate_difference)
  )
```

### **Batsmen Pressure Analysis**

```{r}
batsmen_pressure_analysis <- batter_pressure_data |>
  
  left_join(
    
    raw_data_1 |>
      select(
        match_id,
        winner
      ) |>
      distinct(),
    
    by = "match_id"
  ) |>
  
  mutate(
    
    match_result = case_when(
      
      is.na(winner) ~ NA_character_,
      
      batting_team == winner ~ "Won",
      
      TRUE ~ "Lost"
    )
  )

```

```{r}
pressure_match_data <- batsmen_pressure_analysis |>
  
  group_by(
    season,
    match_id,
    batting_team,
    bowling_team
  ) |>
  
  summarise(
    
    target_runs =
      first(target_runs),
    
    final_score =
      max(
        cumulative_runs,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    wickets_lost =
      max(
        cumulative_wickets,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    result =
      first(match_result),
    
    average_pressure_score =
      mean(
        pressure_score,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    maximum_pressure_score =
      max(
        pressure_score,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    average_required_run_rate =
      mean(
        required_run_rate,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
  )
```
